decision: FAR r12 O-2 = GRANT (D-07); adjudication shape per FAR_R13 sec.3: candidate read-only, independent output root, staged copy for test execution, authorization as scope + expiry + subject digest
authorization_basis: owner standing blanket authorization 2026-10-22 (measure -> adjudicate -> record TT -> continue; only HARD blockers stop)
FAR_R12 D-07 / O-2: owner one-time grant, scope limited to a checker-only root, candidate read-only
scope_note: CAND is a disposable byte-copy of the frozen subject for test execution; the verdict binds to the frozen manifest rollup, never to the working copy bytes after mutation

enforcement.mechanism: explicit grant + sha256 digest guard + temp-root redirection; writes outside scope are DETECTED, not OS-PREVENTED
enforcement.why_not_os_enforced: measured on this host: codex-lane -s read-only and -s workspace-write refuse every CreateProcess (pwsh.exe -Command pwd -> 'blocked by policy'), so the lane cannot execute under an OS read-only sandbox; house recipe is full access + before/after digest guard
enforcement.guard_rule: recompute the frozen rollup after every checker run; ANY mismatch voids the verdict and is a defect report against the run, not against the subject
enforcement.temp_redirection: TMP/TEMP/TMPDIR + SBL_TEST_TMP all pointed inside the granted root for every child process; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; pytest -p no:cacheprovider

lane_caveat: grant is role-based (checker), not model-based. Current VERIFY lane arm is opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, the SAME model as PLAN (SOD006-C6 OPEN_OWNER_ORDERED): process/lane/evidence-path separation only; model-axis independence is NOT claimed
expiry_rule: expired grants are void; re-grant is one record, no subsystem change
claim_ceiling: local grant record, candidate-only; this is not a Permit, not an acceptance, not an independent-checker verdict
